title: Story pack: four more Prophets
notes: Extra pack so the children have more to unlock: Isma'il, Yusuf, Musa and Sulayman, alayhimus salaam, with 4 quiz questions each and 10 Jumu'ah questions. No gems in this pack. The Arabic on every slide is copied word for word from the Uthmani mushaf text published by the Noble Qur'an Encyclopedia (quranenc.com), so it looks a little different from the older stories. Please check: (1) the Zamzam slides cite Sahih al-Bukhari 3364, which I could not open online this time, so check that number; (2) the Isma'il story follows the view that Isma'il was the son in the sacrifice (Surah as-Saffat 37:101-113); (3) the Yusuf story mentions the bowing in 12:100 with the same note as the Adam story; (4) Prophet Lut was skipped for now, and the weekly helper will reach him next week, so please decide if you want that story for the children.

stories.title: Prophet Isma'il and the water of Zamzam

sc.label: A dry valley between bare mountains

slides.text: Prophet Ibrahim, alayhis salaam, brought his wife Hajar and their baby son Isma'il to a dry valley in Makkah. There was no water, no plants and no people. (Sahih al-Bukhari 3364)

ay.ar: رَّبَّنَآ إِنِّيٓ أَسۡكَنتُ مِن ذُرِّيَّتِي بِوَادٍ غَيۡرِ ذِي زَرۡعٍ عِندَ بَيۡتِكَ ٱلۡمُحَرَّمِ
ay.en: Our Lord, I have settled some of my family in a valley with no plants, near Your Sacred House.

sc.label: A glowing lantern in the empty valley at dusk

slides.text: When Ibrahim turned to leave, Hajar asked him: Did Allah command you to do this? He said: Yes. So Hajar said: Then Allah will not leave us. What strong trust in Allah! (Sahih al-Bukhari 3364)

sc.label: Two rocky hills under a hot sun

slides.text: Soon the water ran out, and baby Isma'il was thirsty. Hajar ran up the hill of as-Safa to look for help, then across to the hill of al-Marwah. She did this seven times. (Sahih al-Bukhari 3364)

sc.label: Fresh water bubbling up from the sand

slides.text: Then, by Allah's command, water burst up out of the ground! This blessed water is the well of Zamzam, and it still flows today. (Sahih al-Bukhari 3364)

sc.label: The two hills under a calm evening sky

slides.text: The Prophet ﷺ said that this is why people walk between as-Safa and al-Marwah when they do Hajj and 'Umrah. (Sahih al-Bukhari 3364)

ay.ar: إِنَّ ٱلصَّفَا وَٱلۡمَرۡوَةَ مِن شَعَآئِرِ ٱللَّهِۖ
ay.en: Truly, as-Safa and al-Marwah are among the signs of Allah.

sc.label: A quiet starry night over the valley

slides.text: Isma'il grew old enough to walk and work beside his father. Then Ibrahim saw in a dream that he must sacrifice his dear son. He asked Isma'il what he thought, and Isma'il answered:

ay.ar: فَلَمَّا بَلَغَ مَعَهُ ٱلسَّعۡيَ قَالَ يَٰبُنَيَّ إِنِّيٓ أَرَىٰ فِي ٱلۡمَنَامِ أَنِّيٓ أَذۡبَحُكَ فَٱنظُرۡ مَاذَا تَرَىٰۚ قَالَ يَـٰٓأَبَتِ ٱفۡعَلۡ مَا تُؤۡمَرُۖ سَتَجِدُنِيٓ إِن شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ
ay.en: He said: O my father, do what you are commanded. You will find me, if Allah wills, one of the patient.

sc.label: A bright sunrise over the hills

slides.text: Father and son both obeyed Allah. Then Allah called out to Ibrahim: You have done what the dream asked! Allah saved Isma'il and gave a great sacrifice in his place.

ay.ar: وَفَدَيۡنَٰهُ بِذِبۡحٍ عَظِيمٖ
ay.en: And We ransomed him with a great sacrifice.

sc.label: Building blocks of stone being placed in a row

slides.text: Years later, Ibrahim and Isma'il built the Ka'bah together, the House of Allah. While they worked, they made dua:

ay.ar: وَإِذۡ يَرۡفَعُ إِبۡرَٰهِـۧمُ ٱلۡقَوَاعِدَ مِنَ ٱلۡبَيۡتِ وَإِسۡمَٰعِيلُ رَبَّنَا تَقَبَّلۡ مِنَّآۖ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلۡعَلِيمُ
ay.en: Our Lord, accept this from us. You are the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.

sc.label: A peaceful oasis with palm trees

slides.text: Allah praised Isma'il for always keeping his promises. He told his family to pray and give charity, and Allah was pleased with him.

ay.ar: وَٱذۡكُرۡ فِي ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ إِسۡمَٰعِيلَۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ صَادِقَ ٱلۡوَعۡدِ وَكَانَ رَسُولٗا نَّبِيّٗا
ay.en: Mention Isma'il in the Book. He was true to his promise, and he was a Messenger and a Prophet.

sc.label: A glowing lantern beside an open Qur'an

slides.text: What do we learn? Trust Allah, like Hajar did: Allah never leaves the people who trust Him. Obey Allah even when it is hard, like Ibrahim and Isma'il. And always keep your promises.

quiz.q: What did Hajar say when Ibrahim told her Allah commanded it?
o: Then Allah will not leave us
quiz.why: She trusted Allah completely.

quiz.q: How many times did Hajar run between as-Safa and al-Marwah?
quiz.why: She ran between the two hills seven times.

quiz.q: What is the name of the blessed water that came up?
quiz.why: By Allah's command, the water of Zamzam came up.

quiz.q: What did Ibrahim and Isma'il build together?
quiz.why: They built the Ka'bah and made dua: Our Lord, accept from us.

stories.title: Prophet Yusuf and the dream
stories.sub: Patience, forgiving, and Allah's perfect plan

sc.label: A night sky with eleven stars, the sun and the moon

slides.text: Young Yusuf, alayhis salaam, had a wonderful dream. He told his father, Prophet Ya'qub:

ay.ar: إِذۡ قَالَ يُوسُفُ لِأَبِيهِ يَـٰٓأَبَتِ إِنِّي رَأَيۡتُ أَحَدَ عَشَرَ كَوۡكَبٗا وَٱلشَّمۡسَ وَٱلۡقَمَرَ رَأَيۡتُهُمۡ لِي سَٰجِدِينَ
ay.en: O my father, I saw eleven stars and the sun and the moon. I saw them bowing down to me.

sc.label: A glowing lantern at night

slides.text: Ya'qub knew this dream was special. He told Yusuf to keep it secret from his brothers, because Shaytan likes to make people jealous and unkind.

ay.ar: قَالَ يَٰبُنَيَّ لَا تَقۡصُصۡ رُءۡيَاكَ عَلَىٰٓ إِخۡوَتِكَ
ay.en: O my son, do not tell your dream to your brothers.

sc.label: An old stone well in the desert

slides.text: But the brothers were jealous of how much their father loved Yusuf. They took him out and threw him into a deep well. Allah told Yusuf that one day he would tell them about what they had done.

sc.label: Evening sky over an empty desert

slides.text: The brothers came home crying, with Yusuf's shirt and false blood on it. Ya'qub was very sad, but he said:

ay.ar: وَجَآءُو عَلَىٰ قَمِيصِهِۦ بِدَمٖ كَذِبٖۚ قَالَ بَلۡ سَوَّلَتۡ لَكُمۡ أَنفُسُكُمۡ أَمۡرٗاۖ فَصَبۡرٞ جَمِيلٞۖ وَٱللَّهُ ٱلۡمُسۡتَعَانُ عَلَىٰ مَا تَصِفُونَ
ay.en: So patience is best. And Allah is the One whose help is sought.

sc.label: A town by the river in Egypt

slides.text: Travellers found Yusuf in the well and took him to Egypt. He grew up in a great man's house, and he was good and honest. When he was asked to do something wrong, he refused and said: I seek refuge in Allah!

sc.label: A dark night with a small glowing light

slides.text: Even so, Yusuf was put in prison, though he had done nothing wrong. In prison, he taught the other prisoners about Allah:

ay.ar: يَٰصَٰحِبَيِ ٱلسِّجۡنِ ءَأَرۡبَابٞ مُّتَفَرِّقُونَ خَيۡرٌ أَمِ ٱللَّهُ ٱلۡوَٰحِدُ ٱلۡقَهَّارُ
ay.en: Are many different gods better, or Allah, the One, the All-Powerful?

sc.label: Golden wheat fields along the river

slides.text: The king had a strange dream. Only Yusuf could explain it: seven good years of farming would come, then seven hard years. Yusuf told them to store the grain carefully, and the king put him in charge of the storehouses.

ay.ar: قَالَ ٱجۡعَلۡنِي عَلَىٰ خَزَآئِنِ ٱلۡأَرۡضِۖ إِنِّي حَفِيظٌ عَلِيمٞ
ay.en: Put me in charge of the storehouses of the land. I will guard them well, and I know how.

sc.label: A busy town at sunset

slides.text: In the hard years, Yusuf's brothers came to Egypt to buy food. They did not know him, but he knew them! At last he told them who he was, and he forgave them:

ay.ar: قَالَ لَا تَثۡرِيبَ عَلَيۡكُمُ ٱلۡيَوۡمَۖ يَغۡفِرُ ٱللَّهُ لَكُمۡۖ وَهُوَ أَرۡحَمُ ٱلرَّـٰحِمِينَ
ay.en: No blame on you today. May Allah forgive you, and He is the Most Merciful of all.

sc.label: Bright morning light over the desert

slides.text: Yusuf sent his shirt home to his father. When it was placed on Ya'qub's face, Allah gave his eyesight back. His long patience had a happy ending.

ay.ar: فَلَمَّآ أَن جَآءَ ٱلۡبَشِيرُ أَلۡقَىٰهُ عَلَىٰ وَجۡهِهِۦ فَٱرۡتَدَّ بَصِيرٗاۖ
ay.en: When the bringer of good news came, he put it on his face, and he could see again.

sc.label: Eleven stars, the sun and the moon shining together

slides.text: The whole family came to Egypt, and they bowed to Yusuf, just like the dream. (In those days, bowing to greet someone was allowed. For us, sujood is only for Allah.) Yusuf said:

ay.ar: يَـٰٓأَبَتِ هَٰذَا تَأۡوِيلُ رُءۡيَٰيَ مِن قَبۡلُ قَدۡ جَعَلَهَا رَبِّي حَقّٗاۖ
ay.en: O my father, this is the meaning of my dream from long ago. My Lord has made it come true.

sc.label: A glowing lantern beside an open Qur'an

slides.text: What do we learn? Be patient when things are hard, like Ya'qub. Say no to wrong things, like Yusuf. Forgive people who hurt you. And remember: Allah's plan is always the best plan.

quiz.q: What did Yusuf see in his dream?
o: Eleven stars, the sun and the moon
quiz.why: They were bowing down to him.

quiz.q: Where did the jealous brothers throw Yusuf?
quiz.why: They threw him into a well, but Allah was looking after him.

quiz.q: What did Ya'qub say when he was very sad?
quiz.why: Fasabrun jamil: so patience is best.

quiz.q: What did Yusuf say to his brothers at the end?
quiz.why: He forgave them and asked Allah to forgive them.

stories.title: Prophet Musa and the sea
stories.sub: Allah looks after us, so we can be brave

sc.label: A big city with tall buildings beside the river

slides.text: Long ago in Egypt, there was a proud and cruel king called Fir'awn. He was hurting the Children of Israel, even their baby boys.

ay.ar: إِنَّ فِرۡعَوۡنَ عَلَا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ
ay.en: Truly, Fir'awn made himself high and mighty in the land.

sc.label: A river flowing gently at dawn

slides.text: When baby Musa, alayhis salaam, was born, his mother was afraid for him. Allah told her what to do:

ay.ar: وَأَوۡحَيۡنَآ إِلَىٰٓ أُمِّ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنۡ أَرۡضِعِيهِۖ فَإِذَا خِفۡتِ عَلَيۡهِ فَأَلۡقِيهِ فِي ٱلۡيَمِّ وَلَا تَخَافِي وَلَا تَحۡزَنِيٓۖ إِنَّا رَآدُّوهُ إِلَيۡكِ وَجَاعِلُوهُ مِنَ ٱلۡمُرۡسَلِينَ
ay.en: Feed him, and when you fear for him, put him in the river. Do not be afraid or sad. We will bring him back to you, and make him a Messenger.

sc.label: A palace beside the river

slides.text: She put him in a box and placed it in the river. The water carried it to the palace of Fir'awn! Fir'awn's wife loved the baby at once and said:

ay.ar: وَقَالَتِ ٱمۡرَأَتُ فِرۡعَوۡنَ قُرَّتُ عَيۡنٖ لِّي وَلَكَۖ لَا تَقۡتُلُوهُ
ay.en: A joy to my eyes and yours. Do not kill him.

sc.label: A small house with a warm light at night

slides.text: Baby Musa would not drink milk from anyone. His sister, who was watching, told them about a family who could look after him. So Allah gave Musa back to his own mother, just as He had promised!

ay.ar: فَرَدَدۡنَٰهُ إِلَىٰٓ أُمِّهِۦ كَيۡ تَقَرَّ عَيۡنُهَا وَلَا تَحۡزَنَ وَلِتَعۡلَمَ أَنَّ وَعۡدَ ٱللَّهِ حَقّٞ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكۡثَرَهُمۡ لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ
ay.en: So We gave him back to his mother, so she could be happy and not sad, and know that Allah's promise is true.

sc.label: A fire glowing on a mountain at night

slides.text: Years later, while Musa was travelling with his family, he saw a fire on the side of a mountain. When he came near, Allah spoke to him:

ay.ar: إِنَّنِيٓ أَنَا ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّآ أَنَا۠ فَٱعۡبُدۡنِي وَأَقِمِ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ لِذِكۡرِيٓ
ay.en: Truly, I am Allah. There is no god but Me. So worship Me, and pray to remember Me.

sc.label: A soft glow over the mountain

slides.text: Allah sent Musa to Fir'awn. It was a big job, so Musa made this dua. We can say it too, before a test or when we feel shy:

ay.ar: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱشۡرَحۡ لِي صَدۡرِي وَيَسِّرۡ لِيٓ أَمۡرِي وَٱحۡلُلۡ عُقۡدَةٗ مِّن لِّسَانِي يَفۡقَهُواْ قَوۡلِي
ay.en: My Lord, open my heart, make my job easy for me, and untie the knot in my tongue, so they understand what I say.

sc.label: The proud city under a stormy sky

slides.text: Allah also made Musa's brother Harun a Prophet to help him. They told Fir'awn to worship Allah and let the Children of Israel go. But Fir'awn was too proud, and he refused.

sc.label: The sea at night with an army's dust behind

slides.text: Musa led the believers away at night. Fir'awn and his army chased them right up to the sea. The people cried: They will catch us! But Musa said:

ay.ar: قَالَ كَلَّآۖ إِنَّ مَعِيَ رَبِّي سَيَهۡدِينِ
ay.en: No! My Lord is with me. He will guide me.

sc.label: The sea split into two tall walls of water

slides.text: Allah told Musa to strike the sea with his stick. The sea split into two, and each side stood up like a huge mountain! The believers walked across on dry land.

ay.ar: فَأَوۡحَيۡنَآ إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنِ ٱضۡرِب بِّعَصَاكَ ٱلۡبَحۡرَۖ فَٱنفَلَقَ فَكَانَ كُلُّ فِرۡقٖ كَٱلطَّوۡدِ ٱلۡعَظِيمِ
ay.en: Strike the sea with your stick. And it split, and each side was like a huge mountain.

sc.label: A calm sea under a clear sky

slides.text: Allah saved Musa and everyone with him. When Fir'awn and his army followed, the water closed over them.

ay.ar: وَأَنجَيۡنَا مُوسَىٰ وَمَن مَّعَهُۥٓ أَجۡمَعِينَ ثُمَّ أَغۡرَقۡنَا ٱلۡأٓخَرِينَ
ay.en: And We saved Musa and all who were with him.

sc.label: A glowing lantern beside an open Qur'an

slides.text: What do we learn? Allah looks after us, like He looked after baby Musa. When something is hard, say Musa's dua. And when we are scared, we remember: Allah is with me.

quiz.q: Where did Musa's mother put her baby, as Allah told her?
quiz.why: Allah promised to bring him back to her.

quiz.q: Who said baby Musa was a joy to her eyes?
quiz.why: Fir'awn's wife loved him and said: Do not kill him.

quiz.q: What dua did Musa make before going to Fir'awn?
quiz.why: My Lord, open my heart and make my job easy for me.

quiz.q: What did Musa say when the army was behind them?
o: My Lord is with me, He will guide me
quiz.why: Kalla, inna ma'iya rabbi sa-yahdin.

sc.label: A green valley under a bright sky

slides.text: Prophet Sulayman, alayhis salaam, was the son of Prophet Dawud. Allah made him a king and gave him amazing gifts. He could even understand the speech of birds!

ay.ar: وَقَالَ يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ عُلِّمۡنَا مَنطِقَ ٱلطَّيۡرِ وَأُوتِينَا مِن كُلِّ شَيۡءٍۖ
ay.en: O people, we have been taught the speech of birds, and we have been given something of everything.

sc.label: Strong wind blowing across the land

slides.text: Allah also made the wind obey Sulayman, by Allah's command.

ay.ar: وَلِسُلَيۡمَٰنَ ٱلرِّيحَ عَاصِفَةٗ تَجۡرِي بِأَمۡرِهِۦٓ
ay.en: And for Sulayman, the strong wind blew by his command.

sc.label: A valley with small holes in the ground and tiny flowers

slides.text: One day, Sulayman and his huge army came to a valley of ants. One little ant called out to the others:

ay.ar: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَآ أَتَوۡاْ عَلَىٰ وَادِ ٱلنَّمۡلِ قَالَتۡ نَمۡلَةٞ يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّمۡلُ ٱدۡخُلُواْ مَسَٰكِنَكُمۡ لَا يَحۡطِمَنَّكُمۡ سُلَيۡمَٰنُ وَجُنُودُهُۥ وَهُمۡ لَا يَشۡعُرُونَ
ay.en: O ants, go into your homes, so Sulayman and his army do not crush you without knowing.

sc.label: Sunlight over the quiet valley

slides.text: Sulayman heard her and smiled. Instead of feeling proud, he thanked Allah and made this dua:

ay.ar: فَتَبَسَّمَ ضَاحِكٗا مِّن قَوۡلِهَا وَقَالَ رَبِّ أَوۡزِعۡنِيٓ أَنۡ أَشۡكُرَ نِعۡمَتَكَ ٱلَّتِيٓ أَنۡعَمۡتَ عَلَيَّ وَعَلَىٰ وَٰلِدَيَّ وَأَنۡ أَعۡمَلَ صَٰلِحٗا تَرۡضَىٰهُ وَأَدۡخِلۡنِي بِرَحۡمَتِكَ فِي عِبَادِكَ ٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ
ay.en: My Lord, help me to thank You for the blessings You gave me and my parents, and to do good deeds that please You.

sc.label: A tree with an empty branch

slides.text: Sulayman checked on all the birds. The hoopoe bird was missing! When it came back, it said: I found a land called Saba. A queen rules there, and her people worship the sun instead of Allah.

sc.label: A rolled letter glowing softly

slides.text: Sulayman sent the queen a letter. It began with the name of Allah:

ay.ar: إِنَّهُۥ مِن سُلَيۡمَٰنَ وَإِنَّهُۥ بِسۡمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ
ay.en: It is from Sulayman, and it says: In the name of Allah, the Most Merciful, the Especially Merciful.

sc.label: A row of rich gifts in a hall

slides.text: The queen sent Sulayman expensive gifts. But he was not interested in money. He said:

ay.ar: فَمَآ ءَاتَىٰنِۦَ ٱللَّهُ خَيۡرٞ مِّمَّآ ءَاتَىٰكُمۚ
ay.en: What Allah has given me is better than what He has given you.

sc.label: A palace glowing in the evening

slides.text: Before the queen arrived, her throne was brought to Sulayman faster than the blink of an eye! Sulayman did not boast. He said:

ay.ar: هَٰذَا مِن فَضۡلِ رَبِّي لِيَبۡلُوَنِيٓ ءَأَشۡكُرُ أَمۡ أَكۡفُرُۖ
ay.en: This is from the favour of my Lord, to test me: will I be thankful or not?

sc.label: A shining palace floor that looks like water

slides.text: The queen came and saw Sulayman's palace with a floor of smooth glass. She understood the truth, and said:

ay.ar: رَبِّ إِنِّي ظَلَمۡتُ نَفۡسِي وَأَسۡلَمۡتُ مَعَ سُلَيۡمَٰنَ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
ay.en: My Lord, I have wronged myself, and I submit, with Sulayman, to Allah, the Lord of all the worlds.

sc.label: A glowing lantern beside an open Qur'an

slides.text: What do we learn? Every gift we have is from Allah, so we say Alhamdulillah, like Sulayman. Be kind to small creatures, even ants. And start important things with Bismillah.

quiz.q: What could Sulayman understand?
quiz.why: Allah taught him the speech of birds.

quiz.q: What did the little ant tell the other ants?
quiz.why: She warned them so they would not be crushed.

quiz.q: What did Sulayman do when he heard the ant?
quiz.why: He made dua to be thankful for Allah's blessings.

quiz.q: How did Sulayman's letter to the queen begin?
quiz.why: In the name of Allah, the Most Merciful, the Especially Merciful.

quiz.q: What did Hajar say when Ibrahim told her Allah commanded it?
o: Then Allah will not leave us
quiz.why: She trusted Allah completely.

quiz.q: What is the name of the blessed water that came up?
quiz.why: By Allah's command, the water of Zamzam came up.

quiz.q: What did Ya'qub say when he was very sad?
quiz.why: Fasabrun jamil: so patience is best.

quiz.q: What did Yusuf say to his brothers at the end?
quiz.why: He forgave them and asked Allah to forgive them.

quiz.q: Where did Musa's mother put her baby, as Allah told her?
quiz.why: Allah promised to bring him back to her.

quiz.q: What did Musa say when the army was behind them?
o: My Lord is with me, He will guide me
quiz.why: Kalla, inna ma'iya rabbi sa-yahdin.

quiz.q: What did the little ant tell the other ants?
quiz.why: She warned them so they would not be crushed.

quiz.q: How did Sulayman's letter to the queen begin?
quiz.why: In the name of Allah, the Most Merciful, the Especially Merciful.

quiz.q: Which Prophet's mother put him in the river because Allah told her to?
quiz.why: Allah promised to bring baby Musa back to her, and He did.

quiz.q: Which Prophet forgave his brothers after they threw him in a well?
quiz.why: Yusuf said: No blame on you today.
